title: response_cache
description: Caches responses in memory, per node. Adds X-Apg-Cache: HIT, MISS or BYPASS (spec §9.4).

ttl_secs.description: How long a response is kept when its Cache-Control does not say.

respect_cache_control.description: Honour no-store, private, no-cache, max-age and s-maxage, and never store a response that sets a cookie.

vary_headers.description: Request headers whose values are part of the cache key.

max_object_bytes.description: A larger response is not stored.

cache_authenticated.description: Cache for authenticated callers too, each consumer apart.
